portrait_scale.description: Multiplier applied after the default event-portrait fit. Use it to normalize subject size when transparent canvases contain different framing.

portrait_right.description: Logical-canvas x coordinate used as the portrait texture's right edge.

portrait_y.description: Logical-canvas y coordinate for the top of the portrait texture.

hide_portrait.description: Suppress character art for narration that occurs before the actor becomes visible.

days_after_required_events.description: Minimum full day gap after every required character event completes.

special_requirements.description: Implemented character-event gates. Unknown requirement types remain locked.

preop_stage_id.description: When present, this event auto-starts on entering the named preoperative stage and is excluded from ordinary location entry triggers.
